Unofficial Android build of [WordCraft](https://github.com/storytold/wordcraft) — the real Rust engine and UI on Android tablets.

**Install:** download the `.apk` below, open it on the device, allow "Install unknown apps" if asked. Android 8.0+, arm64.
Verify: `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt`.

Not affiliated with storytold / ArtCraft. See the [README](https://github.com/nideta231/wordcraft) for what's Android-specific and known limits.
